change: GGUF_Q4_DUAL_SILU_PREFILL_OUT_FEATURES admits the TP2 even-split shard width (5_120 -> 8_704) to the dense Q4T16 gate/up+SiLU prefill owner; MlpShardRank.forward_partial attempts that pair at batched rows with the unfused chain as its fallback. Previously the dispatch predicate compared out_features against the unsharded FFN width (17_408) exactly, so a sharded rank's batched prefill ran two t16 WMMA prefill singles plus a separate SiLU-multiply.

kernel_level_parity.method: fused pair vs the unfused chain the shard chain runs (two t16 WMMA prefill shared_b singles + silu_mul_separate_out_bf16), real synthetic Q4_K t16 tiles at in_features=5_120, out_features=8_704

kernel_level_speedup_vs_unfused_chain.note: Isolated back-to-back timing. The band-named variant is fastest in every band, so the existing ladder is reused as-is. An earlier version of this measurement used the plain t16_wmma_prefill single as the control and reported 1.74x at rows=512; the chain actually runs the shared_b single, which is faster, so that figure was overstated and is superseded here.

paired_same_session_ab.method: one session, capability toggled between {17_408} and {17_408, 8_704}, alternating 4 rounds

c1_bench.note: Within run-to-run noise; the paired A/B above is the controlled comparison.

end_to_end_product_path.conclusion: Neutral on the product path. The ~30 ms of chain work removed per prefill is absorbed as extra wait at the per-layer peer exchange, so the sharded MLP phase is rendezvous-bound rather than arithmetic-bound.

control_that_explains_the_effect.method: same paired A/B but WITHOUT logits_rows=1, so the head is projected for all 512 rows
control_that_explains_the_effect.reading: The ~30 ms saving is real and reaches the wall whenever the wall is not sync-bound. This run's wall is dominated by ~560 ms of full-row head projection, which is on the critical path, so the saving shows directly.

end_to_end_bit_identity.method: scripts/tp2_bulk_prefill_diagnostic.py --reduce-mode device, compared against the pre-change run of the same command on the same model and prompts
end_to_end_bit_identity.note: The route's pre-existing KL gap is unchanged and unrelated (identical metrics and digests before and after), so this change neither causes nor hides it.

launch_count.note: 64 layers x 2 ranks; 256 singles + 128 silu replaced by 128 fused pairs.
